newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Danish long yields up to 7.27 pct end-97.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Danish long yields up to 7.27 pct end-97.

text.p: Danish bond yields will climb steadily over the next 12 months, a Reuter consensus poll of 21 economists indicated on Friday.
An average of forecasts showed the benchmark eight percent bond due 2006, currently yielding 6.63 percent, up at 7.27 pct by the end of 1997.

By end-March 1997 the benchmark was seen yielding 6.92 percent, rising to an average 7.14 percent by end-June 1997. The 10-year yield gap with Germany was expected to widen from 82 basis points today to 90 bp in three months, narrowing to 87 bp in 12 months on average.

Three-month rates would rise from 3.58 percent now to an average 3.62 percent in three months, rising to 3.79 percent in six months and 4.13 percent next December, the poll said. --Kenneth Lund Pedersen +45 33969650
